characters.name: Mr. Bennet
characters.description: Father of five daughters, husband to Mrs. Bennet, sarcastic and witty gentleman of Longbourn

characters.name: Mr. Bennet's great-uncle the judge
characters.description: Deceased relative whose portrait hangs at Pemberley

characters.name: Mrs. Bennet
characters.description: Mother of five daughters, wife to Mr. Bennet, obsessed with marrying off her daughters

characters.name: Elizabeth Bennet Darcy
characters.description: Second daughter of the Bennets, witty and intelligent protagonist and Mr. Bennet's favorite, who marries Mr. Darcy

characters.name: Jane Bennet Bingley
characters.description: Eldest and most beautiful Bennet daughter, sweet-tempered and admired by Mr. Bingley, whom she later marries

characters.name: Mary Bennet
characters.description: Middle Bennet daughter, plain, studious, pedantic, plays piano

characters.name: Catherine Bennet
characters.description: Fourth Bennet daughter, often coughs, called Kitty

characters.name: Lydia Bennet Wickham
characters.description: Youngest Bennet daughter, tallest, bold and confident, who eloped with Wickham and is now married to him, wild and unabashed about her situation

characters.name: Mr. Darcy Senior
characters.description: Darcy's late father who was fond of Wickham and left provisions for him in his will

characters.name: Mr. Darcy's father
characters.description: Late master of Pemberley, described as an excellent man, raised Wickham at his own expense

characters.name: Mrs. Long
characters.description: Neighbor who brings news about Netherfield, has two nieces

characters.name: Mr. Morris
characters.description: Person Mr. Bingley agreed with about Netherfield

characters.name: Sir William Lucas
characters.description: Former tradesman, knighted, friendly neighbor to the Bennets, father of Charlotte

characters.name: Lady Lucas
characters.description: Wife of Sir William Lucas, good neighbor to Mrs. Bennet

characters.name: Charlotte Lucas Collins
characters.description: Eldest Lucas daughter, about 27, sensible and practical, Elizabeth's intimate friend who later married Mr. Collins and became mistress of Hunsford Parsonage, managing her household strategically

characters.name: Maria Lucas
characters.description: One of the Lucas daughters, danced with Mr. Bingley

characters.name: A young Lucas
characters.description: Young Lucas boy who came with his sisters, wants foxhounds and wine

characters.name: Mr. Hurst
characters.description: Husband of Mr. Bingley's eldest sister, man of fashion

characters.name: Mr. Robinson
characters.description: Man who asked Mr. Bingley about the Meryton assembly

characters.name: Miss King
characters.description: Woman Mr. Bingley danced with at the ball

characters.name: Colonel Forster
characters.description: Military officer Elizabeth teased about giving a ball at Meryton

characters.name: Fitzwilliam Darcy
characters.description: Wealthy gentleman from Pemberley who admires Elizabeth despite social differences. Initially perceived as proud and ill-natured, he is discerning and connected to Wickham's past.

characters.name: Charles Bingley
characters.description: Wealthy, amiable gentleman who leases Netherfield, shows genuine concern for Jane and kindness to Elizabeth. Jane's love interest who was kept away from her by his sisters.

characters.name: Caroline Bingley
characters.description: Bingley's snobbish sister who pursues Mr. Darcy and criticizes Elizabeth behind her back

characters.name: Louisa Hurst
characters.description: Bingley's married sister who joins Caroline in criticizing Elizabeth and the Bennets

characters.name: Mrs. Philips
characters.description: Mrs. Bennet's sister, married to Mr. Philips, aunt to the Bennet girls who provides gossip about officers

characters.name: Mr. Philips
characters.description: Mrs. Philips's husband, former clerk who succeeded Mrs. Bennet's father as attorney in Meryton

characters.name: Mr. Gardiner
characters.description: Mrs. Bennet's brother settled in London in trade, mentioned in connection with Jane's past admirer

characters.name: Gardiner children
characters.description: Four children of Mr. and Mrs. Gardiner - two girls aged six and eight, and two younger boys

characters.name: Mrs. Gardiner
characters.description: Mr. Gardiner's wife, sister-in-law to Mrs. Bennet

characters.name: Captain Carter
characters.description: Officer admired by Lydia who was going to London

characters.name: Mr. Jones
characters.description: The apothecary who attends to Jane during her illness at Netherfield

characters.name: Miss Watson
characters.description: Young woman in Meryton whom officers Colonel Forster and Captain Carter used to visit

characters.name: Miss Grantley
characters.description: Acquaintance whose table design is compared unfavorably to Miss Darcy's by Caroline Bingley

characters.name: Lady Catherine de Bourgh
characters.description: Mr. Collins's wealthy and proud patroness, widow of Sir Lewis de Bourgh

characters.name: Miss de Bourgh
characters.description: Lady Catherine's sickly daughter, heiress of Rosings

characters.name: Sir Lewis de Bourgh
characters.description: Deceased husband of Lady Catherine

characters.name: Mr. Denny
characters.description: Officer in the regiment who introduces Mr. Wickham to the Bennet sisters

characters.name: Nicholls
characters.description: Servant at Netherfield responsible for making white soup

characters.name: Mrs. Hill
characters.description: Housekeeper and servant at Longbourn (the Bennet household) who brings news of the express letter and receives news of Lydia's upcoming marriage

characters.name: Richard
characters.description: Person Mr. Philips may turn away, whom Colonel Forster might hire

characters.name: Mr. Collins's father
characters.description: Deceased father of Mr. Collins, was illiterate and miserly, quarreled with Mr. Bennet

characters.name: Mr. Collins
characters.description: Clergyman and cousin to the Bennet sisters, obsequious and socially awkward, patronized by Lady Catherine

characters.name: Mr. Wickham
characters.description: Charming officer who claims to have been wronged by Mr. Darcy, son of the late Mr. Darcy's steward

characters.name: Mr. Wickham Senior
characters.description: Wickham's late father who managed the Pemberley estates, described as respectable but poor due to his wife's extravagance

characters.name: The late Mr. Darcy
characters.description: Mr. Darcy's deceased father, Wickham's godfather, described as one of the best men

characters.name: Lady Anne Darcy
characters.description: Deceased sister of Lady Catherine, mother of Mr. Darcy

characters.name: Wickham's father
characters.description: The late Mr. Darcy's steward who devoted his life to managing Pemberley

characters.name: The Archbishop
characters.description: Religious authority mentioned by Mr. Collins regarding propriety of dancing

characters.name: Miss Anne de Bourgh
characters.description: Daughter of Lady Catherine, potential match for Mr. Darcy according to Caroline Bingley

characters.name: Georgiana Darcy
characters.description: Mr. Darcy's sister, praised by Caroline Bingley and expected to dine with the Bingleys

characters.name: Mrs. Jenkinson
characters.description: Companion to Miss de Bourgh, arranges her footstool

characters.name: Lady Metcalfe
characters.description: Acquaintance of Lady Catherine who thanked her for recommending Miss Pope

characters.name: Miss Pope
characters.description: Young person recommended by Lady Catherine as governess, considered a treasure

characters.name: The Miss Webbs
characters.description: Young ladies who all play music despite their father having less income than Mr. Bennet

characters.name: Colonel Fitzwilliam
characters.description: Mr. Darcy's cousin, younger son of an earl, pleasant and sociable gentleman

characters.name: Lord ----
characters.description: Colonel Fitzwilliam's father, an earl

characters.name: Mrs. Younge
characters.description: Governess who presided over Georgiana's establishment, connived with Wickham in the attempted elopement

characters.name: Dawson
characters.description: Lady Catherine's servant who does not object to the barouche-box

characters.name: John
characters.description: Servant Lady Catherine suggests Mrs. Collins send with the young ladies

characters.name: Mrs. Forster
characters.description: Wife of Colonel Forster, young and recently married, Lydia's friend who invites her to Brighton

characters.name: Mary King
characters.description: Young woman Wickham had been pursuing, now gone to Liverpool

characters.name: Harriet Harrington
characters.description: One of the two Harrington sisters, was ill and couldn't attend Mrs. Forster's dance

characters.name: Pen Harrington
characters.description: One of the two Harrington sisters who came alone to Mrs. Forster's dance

characters.name: Chamberlayne
characters.description: Man dressed in women's clothes as a prank at Mrs. Forster's party

characters.name: Pratt
characters.description: One of the officers in the regiment

characters.name: Colonel Miller
characters.description: Colonel whose regiment's departure Mrs. Bennet remembers crying over 25 years ago

characters.name: Mrs. Reynolds
characters.description: Old, respectable housekeeper at Pemberley who praises Mr. Darcy highly and is fond of Wickham

characters.name: Mrs. Annesley
characters.description: Genteel woman who lives with Miss Darcy in London and helps facilitate conversation

characters.name: The little Gardiners
characters.description: The Gardiner children who greet the carriage at Longbourn

characters.name: Harriet Forster
characters.description: Colonel Forster's wife, recipient of Lydia's letter announcing the elopement

characters.name: Sally
characters.description: Servant mentioned in Lydia's letter, asked to mend her muslin gown

characters.name: Haggerston
characters.description: Solicitor mentioned by Mr. Gardiner for preparing the marriage settlement

characters.name: Lady Catherine's daughter
characters.description: Daughter of Lady Catherine, mentioned as agreeing about the scandal's effects on the family

characters.name: The butler
characters.description: Servant at Longbourn who directs the girls to find their father

characters.name: William Goulding
characters.description: Local man Lydia showed her wedding ring to from the carriage

characters.name: Mr. Stone
characters.description: Man who called Mr. Gardiner away on business on Lydia's wedding day

characters.name: The Gouldings
characters.description: Family who might quit Haye Park according to Mrs. Bennet

characters.name: The Lucases
characters.description: Neighboring family Lydia wants to visit

characters.name: Sarah
characters.description: A servant called to help Jane dress
